checks.name: Final extracted bootstrap, login and data preservation
Actual V4.1.2 to V4.1.3 upgrade preserving company state and credentials
Chromium trusted TLS login, redirect, logout and reopen
Final ZIP CRC and every manifest SHA-256; no customer DB/keys/certs
Every distributed PowerShell file UTF-8 BOM and syntax tree; exported client script bytes preserved
Actual Windows PowerShell 5.1/Edge/DPAPI/NTFS and customer LAN/VPN execution

limitations: Executed on Linux/Python 3.12 and Chromium. Native Windows PowerShell preflight was unit-tested with simulated process results; it will run on the actual Windows PC before installation.
Tree-sitter parsing does not reproduce the Windows PowerShell 5.1 ANSI decoding choice. BOM checks and native preflight address that gap.
